## How to use

Download the files you need from **Assets** at the bottom of this page.

### CIA (installs on the HOME menu)

1. Download `virtuanes_3ds.cia`.
2. Copy it to your SD card and install it with a CIA installer such as FBI. Installing a newer version over an older one updates it.
3. Put your ROMs (`.nes` or `.fds`) in any folder on the SD card.
4. Start VirtuaNES from the HOME menu.

### 3DSX (runs from the Homebrew Launcher)

1. Download `virtuanes_3ds.3dsx` **and** `virtuanes_3ds.smdh`. The `.smdh` gives the app its icon and name in the launcher.
2. Copy both to the folder `/3ds/virtuanes_3ds/` on your SD card.
3. Put your ROMs (`.nes` or `.fds`) in any folder on the SD card.
4. Open the Homebrew Launcher and start VirtuaNES.

You only need one of the two: the CIA or the 3DSX.

Famicom Disk System games (`.fds`) also need a BIOS file named `disksys.rom` in `/3ds/virtuanes_3ds/bios/`. It is not included. Your settings are saved in `/3ds/virtuanes_3ds/virtuanes_3ds.cfg`.

See the [README](https://github.com/juanoliveira82/virtuanes_3ds#readme) for more.
